title: Extract one shared DataExportImportService test-fixture builder instead of 5 independently-drifting copies of the export/import schema

evidence.quote: String payload({required List<Map<String, dynamic>> scopes}) => jsonEncode({

why: Five files independently hand-roll the same ~20-key export/import JSON schema (data_export_extended_test.dart alone re-defines it inline 5 separate times within one file). They have already drifted: data_export_import_service_test.dart's buildValidJson still emits a legacy 'activeCurricula' key that its own comment at line 199 says was 'removed from schema v9', while the other four builders omit it entirely. When _requiredSections or a table's columns change, each of these files needs an independent manual update; missing one produces either a spuriously-failing test or a stale fixture that silently stops representing a real export.
recommendation: Extract one shared fixture (e.g. test/helpers/data_export_fixtures.dart) exposing composable per-entity builders -- closest existing model is data_export_import_service_import_test.dart's minimalPayload() + per-entity map functions -- and have all 5 files consume it.
acceptance_criteria: A single shared fixture backs all DataExportImportService import/export payload construction in this test group.
A grep for a second independent 'formatVersion': 'schemaV1' full-schema literal outside the shared fixture returns nothing.
